description: Schema for deterministic per-file Lean4/clean frontend syntax quotation, antiquotation, and hygiene-context artifacts consumed by generate_frontend_classification.py. The generator treats absent artifacts as missing evidence and present artifacts that violate this schema as stale_or_invalid evidence. Valid artifacts remain fail-closed until compared against parse, elaboration, syntax_quotation classifications, and clean parity artifacts.

field_constraints.engine: must equal lean4 or clean and match the path engine segment
field_constraints.filename: must equal the corpus filename, including .lean
field_constraints.source_sha256: must equal the current sha256: digest from tests/lean4_compat/MANIFEST.json
field_constraints.command: must be a non-empty array of non-empty strings
field_constraints.syntax_quotation_status: must be success when quotation_failures is 0; otherwise it must be failure
field_constraints.quotation_failures: must be a non-negative integer less than or equal to quotations_checked plus antiquotations_checked plus hygiene_contexts_checked

optional_evidence_constraints.engine_version: must be a string when present
optional_evidence_constraints.observed_process_status: must be exited or timeout when present; timeout evidence cannot claim syntax_quotation_status success
optional_evidence_constraints.observed_exit_code: must be an integer when present; successful syntax quotation evidence must record exit code 0
optional_evidence_constraints.observed_stdout: must be a string when present
optional_evidence_constraints.observed_stderr: must be a string when present
optional_evidence_constraints.checked_quotations: must be an array of non-empty strings with length equal to quotations_checked when present
optional_evidence_constraints.checked_antiquotations: must be an array of non-empty strings with length equal to antiquotations_checked when present
optional_evidence_constraints.checked_hygiene_contexts: must be an array of non-empty strings with length equal to hygiene_contexts_checked when present
optional_evidence_constraints.observed_eval_results: must be an array of non-empty strings when present
optional_evidence_constraints.artifact_note: must be a string when present
